claims.text: Mebendazole: agranulocytosis and neutropenia have occurred at higher doses and longer durations than recommended; monitor blood counts then.
claims.quote: Agranulocytosis and neutropenia have been reported with mebendazole use at higher doses and for more prolonged durations than is recommended for the treatment of soil-transmitted helminth infections. Monitor blood counts if EMVERM ® is used at higher doses or for prolonged duration.

claims.text: SJS/TEN has been reported with mebendazole plus metronidazole: avoid the combination.
claims.quote: Stevens-Johnson syndrome/toxic epidermal necrolysis (SJS/TEN) have been reported with the concomitant use of mebendazole and metronidazole. Avoid concomitant use of mebendazole, including EMVERM ® and metronidazole.
claims.locator: 5.3 Metronidazole Drug Interaction and Serious Skin Reactions
